therapeutic_hypothesis.claimed_target: dopamine D2 receptor, serotonin 5-HT2 receptor, NK1 receptor, 5-HT3 receptor, glucocorticoid receptor
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: multi-receptor antagonism (dopamine, serotonin, NK1 blockade) combined with corticosteroid anti-inflammatory action
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: cancer patients receiving highly emetogenic chemotherapy (HEC) or moderately emetogenic chemotherapy (MEC)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Proportion of participants with complete response (no vomiting, no rescue therapy) in the overall phase (0–120 hours) for HEC and MEC cohorts

results.effect_size: HEC: 20 vs 15 responders (p=0.397); MEC: 36 vs 40 responders (p=1.0)
subgroup_findings: HEC no-vomiting overall phase: olanzapine 17 vs control 6 (p=0.02)
HEC no-vomiting delayed phase: olanzapine 17 vs control 7 (p=0.005)
HEC no-vomiting acute phase: olanzapine 18 vs control 15 (p=1.0)

dose_info.dose: Olanzapine 5 mg twice daily; Aprepitant 125 mg day 1, 80 mg days 2–3; Palonosetron 0.25 mg IV day 1; Dexamethasone 6 mg IV day 1, 3.75 mg IV days 2–4
dose_info.schedule: Olanzapine orally days 1–4; Aprepitant orally days 1–3; Palonosetron IV 30–60 min before chemotherapy day 1; Dexamethasone IV days 1–4

context.indication: chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting (CINV) in patients receiving HEC or MEC

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Olanzapine's broad receptor antagonism (dopamine D2, 5-HT2) was hypothesized to complement NK1 blockade by aprepitant to further suppress emetic signaling, but the primary endpoint showed no significant difference in complete response rates
modulation_entries.citation: Proportion of Participants Receiving HEC With Complete Response in Overall Phase: Olanzapine Regimen 20 vs Control Regimen 15, p=0.397; MEC: 36 vs 40, p=1.0

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Olanzapine's dopaminergic and serotonergic antagonism was hypothesized to amplify 5-HT3 blockade by palonosetron in preventing CINV, but no significant improvement in complete response was observed
modulation_entries.citation: Proportion of Participants Receiving HEC With Complete Response in Overall Phase: Olanzapine Regimen 20 vs Control Regimen 15, p=0.397
